accuracy_findings.claim: Limits: "[[lex/agent]] is the first to raise your agent limits above zero."
accuracy_findings.problem: This is not always true. Reaction Force needs only Age of Exploration, costs 50 and gives +2 Navarch Limit. A player who owns both can make only Reaction Force active, so their Navarch Limit goes above zero while Age of Exploration is not active. Also, in a game with the Open Court modifier, all three agent limits start at 1 (mutator.ex:366-379, implemented: true), so they are above zero before any lex. The earlier wording, 'gives your first agents', was closer to the guide map's '(Age of Exploration gives the first agents)'. This new wording makes a stronger, checkable claim that is false in these cases.
accuracy_findings.fix: State only what the lex does, for example: "[[lex/agent]], the root of the tree, raises all three agent limits." Or go back to the guide map's wording, 'gives your first agents'. Leave 'starts at zero' and the modifiers to [[agent-limits]].
